steps: Open a new Essential Checking account (deposit $25 or more) or Core Checking account (deposit $10 or more) as the primary account holder.
Make one qualifying direct deposit (recurring payroll, pension or Social Security — not P2P or bank transfers) within 60 days of opening for $150.
Open a USB Debit Card and make 10 signature or PIN debit card purchases within 60 days of opening for $100 (ATM transactions do not count).
At the same time as opening the checking account, open an Essential Savings Account and maintain a $500 average balance or more for 60 days for $150 (new USB savings customers only).
Earn up to $400 total across the components you complete within the 60-day windows.
timing: Each component qualifies within 60 days of account opening; payout timing after qualifying actions not stated in captured terms.
when_cash_arrives: Bonus $150–$400. Per official terms: Each component qualifies within 60 days of account opening; payout timing after qualifying actions not stated in captured terms. Earliest realistic: ~44 days (first payroll DD ~2 weeks + the payout window); the 60-day window is an outer limit.
